limits: No SDK, new native collection, product edit, expected-value edit, evaluator edit, or numeric/pixel threshold adjustment was performed.
Only anonymous allowed evidence was inspected; no assignments, condition labels, participant self-review/claims, old comparison results, controller summary, or other panel output was read.

All 209 distinct original PNG hashes in the qualified checkpoint indices were inspected through 53 full-viewport contact sheets; originals were cropped without resampling and the pasted crop bytes were independently equality-checked against every original. The map retains every original path/hash, frame/state and crop/sheet coordinate. Identical PNG hashes were reused only for inspection; each state/proposition used its own expectation.

Contact sheet resizing in the tool display is presentation only; saved inspection sheets preserve each cropped original pixel. Additional full original images were opened for spot verification of public iOS content. No replacement/rendered image was used as evidence.

A complete spatial sweep does not establish successful action dispatch. The d1cbcd54 iOS action-dependent checkpoint verdicts remain unknown despite complete state-image-index coverage; its replacement did not execute the dirty prerequisite.

Source actuals are restricted to the exact declared files and independent typed datum. Bridge assertions, evidence separation policy and checkpoint fixation cannot be proved by component-only files; they remain unknown. The d1cbcd54 iOS identifier row also remains unknown from source strings/composition alone, with observed runtime defects recorded independently.

Source control-flow judgments describe the written transition/callback logic; they never establish unexecuted runtime behavior, synchronous rendering, computed style, physical hit regions, or entire-domain runtime coverage.

Strict original native geometry and pixel rows are retained. Private option-height rows without fully visible qualified native rectangles remain unassessed; minimum-height declarations and visible wrapping cannot substitute.

The four original automatic failed presence rows are attributed to an unqualified expectation (false_alarm for the claimed transition failure), with original explicit failed dispatch and fixed trigger requirements as the independent basis. The product accessibility/identifier defect that blocks the route is reported separately.
Product findings concern stable native identifier exposure and native option label placement, not unexecuted business state transitions. No broader voiceover usability or all-OS claim is inferred.
